affected_system: food access, environmental health inspection, and community protection
alternatives: screen feasible locations against the largest access gaps for food-access and environmental-health service locations
co-optimize distributed and high-capacity locations for food-access and environmental-health service locations
pair capacitated multi-service access location-allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Food outlets, inspections, assistance, prices, access, and environmental complaints have separate semantics.
Area food access is not treated as individual diet, food security, or health outcome.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain only existing approved locations for food-access and environmental-health service locations.

constraints.description: The food access and environmental health site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: environmental health commissioner and food-access program director
decision_question: Where should mobile markets, benefit navigation, cooling, and field-service access points operate?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The food access and environmental health site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for food-access and environmental-health service locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible people beyond affordable timely service access

intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting food-access and environmental-health service locations, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible people beyond affordable timely service access
distributional gap in eligible people beyond affordable timely service access
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not label a site affordable, culturally appropriate, permitted, or used without evidence.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for food-access and environmental-health service locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
